newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANZ sees lower costs in second half.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANZ sees lower costs in second half.

text.p: Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd said on Wednesday it saw significantly lower costs in the second half of the year to September 30.
"We see our core costs reducing in the second half quite significantly," said ANZ chief executive Don Mercer told a news conference.
ANZ said in its first half results announcement released earlier today it saw the second half benefitting from efficiency changes.
ANZ announced an 18 percent rise in net profit to A$615 million for the six months to March 31.
